metadata.title: SSPP Instance - DNS Secure Email (toronto.edu)
metadata.remarks: Instance SSPP for the toronto.edu apex domain. Declares current DNS Secure Email posture, including absence of MTA-STS enforcement.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative DNS Secure Email governance, security, monitoring, and assessment requirements.

system-characteristics.system-description: Apex institutional domain used for email identity and mailbox sending, governed under DNS Secure Email controls.

props.name: domain-role
props.remarks: Apex domain authorizing mailbox sending and delegating bulk and notification sending to approved subdomains.

props.name: mailbox-sending-pattern
props.remarks: Mailbox sending provided through secure-email (Exchange Online).

props.name: campaign-sending-delegation
props.remarks: Campaign and bulk email is sent only from approved subdomains.

props.name: dmarc-posture
props.remarks: DMARC enforced for the apex domain.

props.name: spf-posture
props.remarks: SPF centrally managed and restricted to approved mailbox senders.

props.name: dkim-posture
props.remarks: DKIM required for all authorized senders.

props.name: transport-security
props.remarks: MTA-STS is not currently enforced for the toronto.edu domain. TLS reporting may be partially or not enabled.

components.title: toronto.edu Apex Email Domain
components.description: Authoritative DNS domain for email identity and delivery.

links.text: Inherits DNS Secure Email governance and enforcement expectations.

components.remarks: All non-mailbox sending is prohibited at the apex and must occur via explicitly approved subdomains.

control-implementation.remarks: DNS Secure Email controls are largely satisfied via inherited governance. Absence of MTA-STS enforcement is expected to be recorded as an Amber assessment finding.
